ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited's subsidiary has commissioned an additional 66.68 MW of solar capacity, bringing its operational contribution to the 300 MW Hybrid Power Project to 133.36 MW. This positive operational milestone enables revenue generation from October 7, 2026, under its Power Purchase Agreement with NTPC Limited, significantly enhancing the company's asset base and future cash flow. There are no immediate red flags, indicating successful project execution and progress towards full commissioning.
